# TryIPTV

> TryIPTV is a prepaid IPTV service with 25,000+ live channels and 120,000+ movies and TV shows (counted from our channel and on-demand lists, October 2026), watched on your own devices through compatible IPTV player apps. Plans start at $15.82 with 2 connections, no automatic renewal and a 24-hour free trial.

The linked website pages hold the current facts. Pricing, trial terms, and refund conditions are governed by their respective pages. Device pages cover platform setup; player pages cover app configuration; guides explain concepts; help pages diagnose problems.

## Company

- [About TryIPTV](https://www.tryiptv.com/about): TryIPTV sells its own subscriptions and issues the login details itself; you watch through a compatible IPTV player app. Operated by Karim Adeyemi (New York, United States; company registration number 8683949, New York Department of State; operating since 2021). Founder / Operations: Simo Alaoui. Support on WhatsApp and email, 9:00 AM–10:00 PM ET, every day including weekends and public holidays; replies typically within 15 minutes during those hours, and messages sent outside them are answered when support reopens.

## IPTV concepts

- [Guides](https://www.tryiptv.com/guides): Browse educational explanations.
- [What is IPTV?](https://www.tryiptv.com/guides/what-is-iptv): Definition and basic viewing requirements.
- [What is M3U?](https://www.tryiptv.com/guides/what-is-m3u): Playlist format and stream entries.
- [What are Xtream Codes?](https://www.tryiptv.com/guides/what-are-xtream-codes): Server URL, username, and password login method.
- [M3U vs Xtream Codes](https://www.tryiptv.com/guides/m3u-vs-xtream-codes): Comparison and choice of connection method.
- [What is EPG?](https://www.tryiptv.com/guides/what-is-epg): Programme schedule data and its relationship to XMLTV.

## Troubleshooting

- [Help](https://www.tryiptv.com/help): Find the guide matching the failure symptom.
- [IPTV not working](https://www.tryiptv.com/help/iptv-not-working): Triage for a general failure.
- [Login not working](https://www.tryiptv.com/help/iptv-login-not-working): Diagnose rejected credentials or server access.
- [M3U not loading](https://www.tryiptv.com/help/m3u-not-loading): Diagnose playlist download or parsing failures.
- [EPG not working](https://www.tryiptv.com/help/epg-not-working): Diagnose missing or incorrect guide data.
- [IPTV buffering](https://www.tryiptv.com/help/iptv-buffering): Diagnose interrupted playback.
